thread:
mira: Quick sync — RC1 pricing/packaging migration: target timeline next week. Need final owners for metering, billing, quotas, and contract appendix. What are the remaining blockers? cc @jonathan @samir @alicia @legal-ana

jonathan: Metering owner here. PR #412 adds prefix-based meter buckets and adjusts sample rate. Reviews in progress; infra feature flag needed and one perf run. If reviews land I can merge Mon EOD.

samir: Billing update: migration script (billing/migrate_v2.sql) is ready. We are switching rounding to per-batch instead of per-request — this will change billing for a small set of legacy plans. We need the final quota mapping table before execution.

alicia: I will own quota mapping & rollout automation. Ill open a PR with the mapping CSV + a small transformer (python) today. Will include test cases for grandfathering.

sre-liz: SRE side: propose Tue 02:00-03:30 UTC for schema migration (lowest traffic). Require rollback steps and feature-flag gating. Also note Samirs sampling change may cause a temporary throughput spike on Dedicated; we should plan for short capacity increases.

legal-ana: Drafted contract appendix covering "quota carryover" and grandfathering rules; pinged product for a review. Aiming for legal signoff Tue 17:00 — flag anything that expands scope.

jonathan: Technical blocker: runtime KV cache needs a small invalidation tweak so old cached prefixes don't lead to double-counting. I have a patch but want eng-runtime to CR.

eng-runtime-bot: deploy-checklist: runtime-patch #220 queued. CI: unit tests 18/18 passed, perf bench pending.

mira: Action list I have so far:
- @jonathan finish CR + merge
- @alicia open quota mapping PR and add test cases for grandfathering
- @samir align sampling doc with SRE and prepare canary jobs
- @legal-ana confirm appendix by Tue 17:00
- @sre-liz confirm migration window and rollback steps

samir: Billing will run a canary (5% accounts) for 48h before full switch. Ill add a rollout job in billing-ops and dashboard alerts.

alicia: PR opened: PR#674 in quota-maps. Includes mapping CSV + transformer and tests for three legacy scenarios. Marked one row as "manual review" for mixed-legacy-plan accounts. Pinging @jonathan for mapping validation.

jonathan: Reviewing now. Two small comments on prefix overlap semantics; will push fixes in ~2h.

mira: Decision check: if legal signs off Tue EOD and infra feature flag is green Mon, we run Tue night migration (prod) and Wed start canary. If anything slips, shift full canary to Thu. Agreed?

samir: :thumbsup: from Billing. Preparing canary dashboard, alerting, and rollback hooks.

legal-ana: :thumbsup: barring scope creep. Ill update appendix with concrete examples from Alicias mapping.

sre-liz: +1. Ill post the migration runbook in #eng-oncall and schedule a Fri dry-run (non-prod) to validate scripts and rollback. Also will coordinate capacity bump window with infra.

mira: Noted. If any owner hits blockers DM me. Readiness doc: https://docs.redwood/pricing/rc1-readiness

deploy-bot: scheduled migration job created: migration/rc1-2026-03 (dry-run Fri non-prod)

alicia: Quick note: CSV has a corner case for customers with mixed legacy plans — marked as manual review so Billing can verify before canary.

jonathan: Metering PR merged at 2168766890. Runtime patch pending eng-runtime approval but CI is green.

eng-runtime: Reviewed and approved runtime patch #220. Marked patch for canary rollout. Please ensure perf bench results are attached to the canary dashboard.

mira: Final owners = metering: jonathan, billing: samir, quotas: alicia, legal: legal-ana, SRE: sre-liz. Ill post a readout after the dry-run and coordinate the Tue night slot if everything goes green. Last_message by mira — will update after dry-run.
